description: This PHP source file defines the MenuItemAPI class for the OrangeHRM mobile module. It provides an API endpoint to retrieve the list of menu items available to the user in the mobile app, including differentiation based on user roles and enabled modules such as 'leave' and 'time'. It constructs menu items dynamically depending on user permissions and module statuses, and returns structured data including metadata about leave and timesheet periods.
